description: Searches a directory of real small local businesses in Europe whose details were confirmed by their owners. The query is the customer's own words, e.g. 'property management in Alicante' or 'online QA course'. Returns up to five close matches with name, short description, city, an online flag, service languages, a relevance score and the page URL. The directory is small: an empty result means the directory has no such business. Each result includes the business's city and an online flag; a business located in another city is not a local match.

city.description: City the customer named (e.g. 'Alicante'). Keeps only businesses located there. Not needed when the customer wants an online service.

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
